items.rationale: The road bike is a means of transport excluded by 4.3(b). Its replacement frame is not indemnifiable under 7.1.8(a).
Clause 4.3(b) expressly excludes the bicycle and its braking assemblies; 7.1.8(a) excludes the replacement cost.
Carriage for the excluded bicycle is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(a).
The workshop attended only to the excluded bicycle, so its vehicle charge is not payable under 7.1.8(a) and (f).
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes assembly and fitting work on the uninsured bicycle.
Under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10, sundries used solely for the bicycle repair follow the exclusion of that work.
Clause 7.1.8(a) excludes labour of every grade on the uninsured bicycle, including this apprentice hour.
All three hours relate to the excluded bicycle and are non-payable under 7.1.8(a).
Clause 7.1.7(g) allows one attendance by the locksmith for the covered door repair. Allow €76 gross for the single visit, with no stated deductible adjustment.
Fitting and adjusting the replacement lock are covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d). Allow €65 gross for distinct fitting work, without duplicating separately billed labour under 7.1.8(g).
Clause 7.1.7(f) covers small parts and consumables incorporated into the damaged lock and strike-area repair. Allow €20 gross for one sundry lot.
Clauses 7.1.7(e) and 11.3 cover necessary apprentice labour on the affected door. Allow one hour at €40 gross.
Clause 7.1.7(e) covers necessary skilled labour to restore the forced back-door lock. Allow one hour at €95 gross.
